$comment: Art direction for hewittservices.net. All 23 images were generated with Artlist (Seedream 5.0, 2K) into the firm's Artlist library. The session that built this site could not write the binaries into the repo because Artlist's CDN hosts sit outside its network egress allow-list, so run `npm run fetch:images` from a machine with normal internet access to populate public/images/. Until a file exists the site renders a navy/gold gradient panel in its place (see lib/media.ts) - nothing 404s and no code change is needed when the files arrive.
note: sourceUrl values are signed Artlist CDN links and may expire. If a download returns 403, re-download that image from the Artlist library using its generationId, or regenerate it from the prompt recorded here.
stillNeededFromClient: public/images/demarcus-hewitt.jpg - photograph of Demarcus Hewitt. Deliberately NOT generated: a synthetic or stock face standing in for a real, named person would misrepresent the firm.
Logo files, to replace the typographic wordmark in components/Logo.tsx and the placeholder favicon at public/favicon.svg.

images.alt: The downtown Dallas skyline at blue hour, seen across open ground
images.prompt: Wide cinematic editorial photograph of the downtown Dallas, Texas skyline at blue hour, shot from a slight elevation across open ground. Deep navy sky graduating to charcoal, warm gold window lights glowing in the towers, faint reflection on glass. Calm, premium, restrained. Soft atmospheric haze, muted contrast in the upper third so white headline text can sit over it legibly. No text, no words, no lettering, no logos, no signage.

images.usedFor: Dallas page hero / services hub hero
images.alt: A Dallas office district in late afternoon light, with stone and glass facades
images.prompt: Editorial architectural photograph of a Dallas, Texas office district in late afternoon — mid-rise modern buildings, clean glass and stone facades, a broad quiet street, mature trees. Warm low sun raking across the stone, deep navy shadows. North Texas light. Muted contrast, room at the top of the frame for overlay text. No text, no signage, no logos.

images.alt: The Fort Worth skyline at dusk under a wide Texas sky
images.prompt: Editorial photograph of the Fort Worth, Texas downtown skyline at dusk across the Trinity River flats. Distinctly Fort Worth — lower, warmer, more brick and limestone than a glass megacity, art-deco tower silhouettes, wide Texas sky. Deep navy and indigo sky with warm amber city light. Clearly a different city and composition from the Dallas shot. No text, no signage, no logos.

images.usedFor: About page hero and inline office image
images.alt: A small accounting office with an oak desk, a desk lamp and neatly stacked folders
images.prompt: Interior photograph of a small, refined accounting practice office. Warm oak desk, a single green-shaded lamp, neat stacks of closed folders, a leather chair, bookshelf with muted spines, tall window with soft daylight. Deep navy walls, brass and gold hardware, ivory paper tones. Quiet, ordered, trustworthy. No people, no text, no readable documents.

images.alt: An organized bookkeeping desk with a laptop, a columnar ledger pad and neatly clipped receipts under warm light
images.prompt: Overhead editorial still life of a monthly bookkeeping workspace: an open laptop showing an abstract clean line chart, a columnar ledger pad, a pen, a small stack of neatly squared receipts held by a brass clip, a cup of black coffee. Deep navy desk, ivory paper, warm gold rim light from the left. Orderly and calm. No text, no numbers, no readable screens.

images.alt: Two advisers reviewing hand-drawn diagrams in a notebook across a dark walnut conference table
images.prompt: Editorial photograph of a tax strategy planning session, shot from behind and to the side so no faces are visible — two people at a dark walnut conference table, one gesturing toward an open notebook with hand-drawn abstract diagrams, a tablet and a fountain pen nearby. Deep navy room, warm gold window light. Composed, advisory rather than salesy. No visible faces, no text, no readable documents.

images.alt: A tidy desk with a blank tax form, a slim calculator, reading glasses and a fountain pen under warm light
images.prompt: Editorial still life of individual tax preparation: a tidy desk with a blank unmarked form on cream paper, a slim silver calculator, reading glasses folded on top, a fountain pen, and a plain manila folder squared to the edge. Deep navy desk, single warm gold key light from upper left. Precise, calm, meticulous. No text, no numbers, no readable documents.

images.usedFor: Back Taxes and Compliance service page
images.alt: Kraft file folders standing in an archival box with aligned tabs, one lifted forward, under warm light
images.prompt: Editorial photograph of several years of tax records being brought back into order: a row of kraft file folders standing in a dark archival box, tabs neatly aligned, one folder lifted slightly forward. Warm gold light falling across the tabs, deep navy background fading to black. The mood is relief and resolution, not shame or clutter. No text, no handwriting, no labels.

images.alt: An unopened window envelope on a walnut table beside reading glasses and a cup of coffee in morning light
images.prompt: Editorial still life: a single plain unopened government-style window envelope on a dark walnut table, slightly angled, beside a pair of reading glasses and a cup of coffee going cold. Morning light from a window off frame, long soft shadow, deep navy tones with a warm gold highlight along the envelope edge. Serious but solvable, not frightening. No text, no stamps, no addresses.

images.usedFor: Texas Franchise Tax Reinstatement service page
images.alt: A small Texas main-street brick and limestone storefront in golden hour light
images.prompt: Editorial photograph of a small Texas main-street business exterior at golden hour — warm red brick and limestone storefront, large clean plate-glass window, a simple awning, wide Texas sky with deep navy dusk creeping in. Independent, established, back in good standing. No text, no shop names, no signage.

images.alt: A plain matte navy payment card with a brushed gold edge on a dark surface under a soft light sweep
images.prompt: Clean editorial product-style still life suggesting faster access to funds: a plain matte navy payment card with a brushed gold edge resting at an angle on a dark surface, a soft gold light sweep behind it. Abstract, restrained, banking-grade — no branding of any kind, no cardholder details. Studio lighting, deep navy background. No text, no numbers, no card networks.

images.alt: A deep navy fluted stone wall crossed by a single band of warm gold light
images.prompt: Abstract architectural detail photograph: a deep navy coffered ceiling or fluted stone wall lit from a low angle, with a single thin band of warm gold light running across it. Minimal, geometric, quiet. Almost monochrome navy with one gold accent. Very muted contrast, generous negative space. No text, no people.

images.alt: A small office waiting area with two leather chairs and a brass floor lamp
images.prompt: Editorial interior photograph of a small professional office entry and waiting area: two simple leather chairs, a low walnut table with a single plant, a warm brass floor lamp, deep navy wall, daylight through a glass door. Welcoming and calm, human-scale, a small firm rather than a corporate lobby. No people, no text, no signage.

images.usedFor: Default Open Graph / Twitter share image
images.alt: Hewitt Services — tax and accounting services in Dallas, Texas
images.prompt: Premium abstract brand backdrop for a financial firm's social share card: a deep navy field with subtle paper-grain texture, crossed by two clean thin gold rules and a soft pool of warm light in the lower right. Extremely minimal, lots of empty space in the left two thirds for a headline. No text, no logos, no people, no objects.

images.alt: A laptop, a stack of folders and a cup of coffee on an oak table by a window looking out over open Texas country at dusk
images.prompt: Wide cinematic editorial photograph of working with an accountant from a distance: an open laptop on a warm oak table beside a neat stack of closed folders, a phone resting face-down, a cup of black coffee, and a wide window looking out over open Texas country at dusk. Interior lit by a single warm lamp. Calm, competent, unhurried. Muted contrast with room in the upper left for white headline text. No people, no text, no logos.
